faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VNMKV Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 15th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 38 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. (Agriculture) degree in Agronomy to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q4. How will the selection be made for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an email application, followed by shortlisting, an interview, and document verification. Candidates must perform well in each stage.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the VNMKV Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- along with 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position announced by Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the designated official email address.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth located?
faq.answer: Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth is located in Parbhani, Maharashtra, with the pincode 431402.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are generally required for the application?
faq.answer: Typically, you will need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.
